n: \"TRACE_NOT_AVAILABLE\"` when the iteration finished without a stored trace.\n- [Get an iteration's step results](https://docs.

inished run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that is not completed and passed (c
ancelled and skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases — see the rerun preview. The new run records `rerunOfRun

ecent runs for a suite, newest first.\n- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/
